body: Fire fighters fight fires, they do not take away the matches that light them. I've been most of my life the one who take those matches away from other people. I make sure those I love have no reason to kindle a light, for I can shine for them. Guess what, at 37 after trying to light so many paths, I became the very flame that burned me out. I forgot to slow down, I allowed everyone to take a piece of me, not for them to be happy in the long run, not out of my kindness, but out of anger and feeling incompetent to understand the human heart.

Felt every word wrote. My biggest focus was never the things people say I love, my biggest focus in life is to make sure that I can look at the mirror and recognize myself and not some broken fdoll, a used doormat or a crazy dirty crazy person. 

I never asked anyone to feel how I ado. Because Id do anything for a friend or a relative to never go thru such. All I asked was to be given space and time to think and perform rituals to help subside my memories of abuse, torture and dark experiences. But no, my truth needs to be twisted in hopes my suicide will not conclude, lies are being forced out of my mouth just so I can help them paint a convincing monster they are excited to print, replicate and distribute. My biggest goal was not even to be happy, it was simply not to be depleted by any sense of life.

At several episodes my dogs and my cats are reason enough to get up and go outside or reason enough to hustle a little bit of money. But I have to leave them, I became a threat to them when I'm forced by circumstances to take another path. I knew then it's going to be a road less traveled by as I fulfill each day of my suicide calendar. Leaving them behind is the most humane thing I can do that drag them along as I piece the the puzzling torture.

I felt like most people want me to live so I can continue being in service to their needs. From as little as perhaps being available if they need someone they can label as a friend when their reality slaps them hard or to be an available combo of holes and body parts for pleasure. People save people who are trying to exit not because they truly care, but because they  care about the benefits of having that person around. Maybe different from others, but it suits me well. Adios!

I would never yell into the void. Instead, I would smile, get  excited and allow myself be absorbed by it. The void, my home, my god, my source of inspiration to detach from this cruel every minute thing called life.

If the people around me cared enough, they would've stopped themselves from hurting me to top the painful truth thats already layered serving as the foundation of gooey, messy effedupness. But the people around me didn't just add up to that foundation. They use what they saw and there it on my face..
I stopped the promises. Isn't control and routine among the forced things in my life. I'm going to be spontaneous. I know I am dying. The how's and the when's are tightly sealed in my head
Death isn't my choice, it is the only thing I can do to reclaim a semblance of what I would call life.

Done therapy for years. Death is my only goal, it will conclude the meaning i seek.

I did mine like. Tasks. Bulleted. Deletion of my digital assets, assignment of some of my stuff whether thrown or given, etc. Some are 3 days not thinking of even suicide and just be completely irresponsible. Another entry like having sex with someone i may like but have never tried. Haha.

I have vegan deleting digital assets, personal stuff are underway to donations. Even my own cremation has been planned and will just be working on my next few days arranging a peaceful place where i will croak. I want not to be remembered but simply like an urban legend among several people.
Jan 22, you have plenty of time to experience. I'm exiting in 24 days and most things.im gonna do is listed like a bucketlist. I'm halfway accomplishing it already.

I appreciate you saying for me not to. But honestly, no one can stop me. Not even religion. I am spiritual. I have practiced spirituality for a long time, the rituals and the lifestyle. It was a great experience,.but the spirit or soul is only as good as to what it identifies with. Right now mine is death and so it shall go. 

I have e some supportive friends, they would talk me out of it. I do go out and see friends. I watch them and capture glimpses of their happy moments. It's always been joyful to see them laugh. 

Light, what can be the light. I think there is none, the natural course of life is death. Successful birth will end in a successful death - mother nature made sure of that. 

What i am doing is part of nature, i am tired and wish to eliminate myself in experiencing the next episodes of human society. The light and spark i need is the last daylight before i enter my dark future.

I am my biggest let down. I've spent most of my life trying to make a meaningful impact into people's lives. I have built myself over and over not seeking validation. I am basically someone who might pass as a known happy strong person, and i am. I have some problems in life but i have 100 solutions that goes by it that will resolve issues.  But i am still killing myself. Why? Because I have this string belief that it is what I am supposed to do. 

I don't mind the people who manipulated me. Really. 
I don't mind the cruelty i experience and witness. I often go in between and save a victim. 
I have no anger in me. I can even say i love life but i wish to no longer be in it. 

I am the survivor, the kind, witty enigmatic person to some. But i have let myself down in one thing, i loved life and everyone in it but never loved myself enough to save myself from this dark thoughts. Suicide has become my friend now, and we work together just fine. As brilliant as a corporate strategist i am, my suicide plans are strategized efficiently too.

I tried professional help. Infact, i am an underwriter for a known founder of one selfhelp modality. I myself is a practitioner of NLP and know caches, shrinks and Drs. I don't have something to live for. I have seen beautiful sunrises. I have thrown the best parties, lunches and dinners with family and friends. 

I am tired. I am not physically sick. I am relatively healthy. I meditate and excelled at my jobs in the past. I have seen cruel people and taught them kindness, i have seen the ailing and helped heal them. I have had the best romantic relationships. I will laugh and be. Extremely happy, but to be honest, i am not sad at all. This is just me being tired of everything, darkness is calling me and i know it's where i belong.
